name: lazygit
summary: Terminal UI for git. Themeable borders and selection colors, Nerd Font icons, custom keybindings and pluggable diff renderers (delta).
configFormat: YAML (config.yml); repo overrides in <repo>/.git/lazygit.yml and .lazygit.yml in parent dirs

install.notes: In the extras bucket: scoop bucket add extras.

windows.notes: Docs default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\lazygit\config.yml (also found in %APPDATA%\lazygit\config.yml). Observed on Windows 11 with XDG_CONFIG_HOME set: `lazygit --print-config-dir` returned <XDG_CONFIG_HOME>/lazygit, so ask lazygit for the directory before writing.

macos.notes: Docs: default is ~/Library/Application Support/lazygit/config.yml; export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$HOME/.config" to use ~/.config/lazygit.

install.notes: Debian 13+ and Ubuntu 25.10+ (README); older releases: download the release tarball (README gives a curl/tar snippet).
Fedora 43 has 0.66.3 in the main repo; older Fedora needs a copr (README: dnf copr enable dejan/lazygit).

integration.notes: delta diff renderer, editor, Nerd Font icons, shell alias.
